offering_description.value: Sells billing, customer care, and payment software and related managed services to communications, media, and entertainment providers, such as pay-TV, broadband, and telecom operators. It delivers software as licenses, cloud subscriptions, and outsourced operations.

primary_products.value: billing software; customer engagement software; payment processing software; digital monetization software

primary_services.value: managed billing operations; cloud hosting; implementation and consulting; customer care outsourcing

customer_segment.value: B2B: cable, satellite, and telecom operators, media and entertainment companies

end_markets.value: telecommunications; cable and pay-TV; media and entertainment; broadband

revenue_model.value: subscription: cloud software subscriptions paid by operators; licensing or royalties: software licenses for on-premise billing platforms; service fees: managed operations, implementation, and support fees; transaction or usage fees: payment processing fees based on transaction volume
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: builds billing and customer engagement platforms, sold to communications and media providers; service provider: runs billing and customer care operations for operators on a contract basis

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific customers

specialization.value: related lines: billing, customer care, and payment software and services sharing communications and media customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to large operators; partners / resellers: systems integrators and technology partners that deploy solutions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment card security and data privacy rules, such as PCI DSS and GDPR, apply

notes: Product and segment mix may have changed recently; description is based on general knowledge.
